newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bobst sees profit, sales growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Bobst sees profit, sales growth in 1997.

text.p: Bobst AG, a Swiss manufacturer of packaging machinery, said it expected sales and profit to rise in 1997, but gave no exact forecasts.

"Despite continuing economic uncertainty, especially in Europe, we expect sales to increase and profits to rise thanks to improved efficiency in the group as well as to development in Swiss franc parities," it said in a statement.

Demand remains restrained in European by countries trying to joint the single currency, but is strong in North America. Asia is also developing well, but can compensate for Europe only partially. Customers in Latin America, the Middle East and eastern Europe are also showing growing interest, it said.
